title: Does exactly what I need it to
body:
I tried a couple dozen habit tracking and checklist apps before settling on this one. This is a simple and straight forward app with a minimalist design. You make lists, add tasks to the list, and check them off each day that you do them. It doesn’t reward you for streaks, or show you stats (aside from the visual of the check marks), or remind you to do anything. You don’t even enter goals into the app. 
Everything else I tried failed at one of these points: wouldn’t let me make lists/subcategories (I want work goals in a different place than fitness goals), would try and force me to choose a day things were due (I don’t care which three days I run in a given week), or limited the number of habits/tasks (I want to track a bunch of stuff).
This app likely won’t be what most people are looking for, but for what I need it’s perfect.
